_doc: Combat rules shared by real battles and headless ones (BattleRules.gd). Intents: each enemy's next action is planned and shown ahead of time; bosses charge their signature/ultimate for a turn first. Break: weakness hits (and combos) fill an enemy's break meter; at its threshold the enemy is Broken - it loses its next turn, takes extra damage until then, and a charge is cancelled. Link: a party gauge that fills from hits, combos and breaks; ultimates spend it, LINK skills add to it and pull the next ally forward, Unison Strike spends a full gauge for an attack by the whole party.

break._doc: Break counts weakness hits (damage type or element the enemy is weak to): each is 1 point, a hit that also triggers a combo is 1 more. Neutral hits don't count. At the enemy's threshold it is Broken; each break raises that enemy's threshold by growth_per_break.
